You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 36733a891fb56594fcee580f667b33a64b990981 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: John Crispin <blogic@openwrt.org>
Date: Fri, 1 Aug 2014 18:12:36 +1000
Subject: [PATCH] pppd: Fix a stack variable overflow in MSCHAP-v2

This fixes a bug introduced in 08ef47ca ("pppd: Make MSCHAP-v2 cope
better with packet loss").

Signed-off-by: Paul Mackerras <paulus@samba.org>
---
 pppd/chap_ms.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/pppd/chap_ms.c b/pppd/chap_ms.c
index 016b42e..c2bd00f 100644
--- a/pppd/chap_ms.c
+++ b/pppd/chap_ms.c
@@ -382,7 +382,7 @@ chapms2_make_response(unsigned char *response, int id, char *our_name,
 		      unsigned char *private)
 {
 	const struct chapms2_response_cache_entry *cache_entry;
-	unsigned char auth_response[MS_AUTH_RESPONSE_LENGTH];
+	unsigned char auth_response[MS_AUTH_RESPONSE_LENGTH+1];
 
 	challenge++;	/* skip length, should be 16 */
 	*response++ = MS_CHAP2_RESPONSE_LEN;
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a stack variable overflow due to the `auth_response` array being defined with a size of `MS_AUTH_RESPONSE_LENGTH`, which was insufficient to hold the required data. The patch corrected this by increasing the size of the array to `MS_AUTH_RESPONSE_LENGTH + 1`, allowing for proper storage of the response and preventing overflow. This issue was introduced in a previous commit that aimed to improve the handling of packet loss in the MSCHAP-v2 implementation.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a stack variable overflow due to the `auth_response` array being defined with a size of `MS_AUTH_RESPONSE_LENGTH`, which was insufficient to hold the required data. The patch corrected this by increasing the size of the array to `MS_AUTH_RESPONSE_LENGTH + 1`, allowing for proper storage of the response and preventing overflow. This issue was introduced in a previous commit that aimed to improve the handling of packet loss in the MSCHAP-v2 implementation.
